name: Commission proposal
title: Dates of application and transitional provisions for chemical products ***I
part_text:
The European Union wants to agree a common position before a global wildlife trade meeting in November 2025. At that meeting, countries decide which animals and plants get extra protection from trade. The EU plans to put forward seven proposals to add species to the protected lists, plus one list of species it already regulates. The EU will support these proposals at the meeting. The deadline to submit them is 27 June 2025.

- Seven species proposals go to the wildlife trade meeting; one listing is still being decided.
- It affects traders and countries that export these species, plus EU import rules.
- Proposals must be sent by 27 June 2025; the meeting runs 24 November to 5 December 2025.
